text: Thus, the world, asleep through the habit of false conceptualizations, does not awaken while perceiving a non-existent object as if in a dream, and does not perceive its absence as it truly is. But when one awakens through the attainment of transcendental non-conceptual knowledge that opposes this, one then perceives the absence of the object as it truly is, owing to the pure worldly knowledge obtained subsequent to that. This is similar.
